result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there is a clear text-overlap defect in the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing where '25–30 min delivery' collides with '€0 delivery', making both unreadable. A minor issue exists with a partially cut-off restaurant card at the screen edge.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time text '25–30 min delivery' overlaps with '€0 delivery', producing garbled, unreadable text ('€0rdelimiivery')
issues.suggestion: Fix the text positioning/overflow so the delivery time and delivery fee render in separate, non-overlapping lines or spaces

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen with its name truncated
issues.suggestion: If this is an intentionally scrollable carousel it is acceptable, but ensure there is a visible affordance (e.g., partial peek with scroll hint) so users know more cards exist; otherwise adjust card widths to fit

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g., 'Pizza', 'Sushi') use light gray text on light gray backgrounds with low contrast
issues.suggestion: Increase text/background contrast for filter chips to meet WCAG AA standards
